mods.name: Classic Sun Rotation
mods.description: Rotates the sun/moon back to their classic state, rising in north and going down in south.

releases.notes:
Shadows generated by shaders are now correctly following the new sun position.

Thanks to Andrew (@Gaider10) for helping out! 

## Change log
- Fix Iris shaders shadows not being correctly rotated.
- Refactored some code.
- Full Changelog: https://github.com/MinecraftAtHome/ClassicSunRotation/compare/v1.1.1...v1.2.0

## Compatibility
- Tested with Fabric 1.19.3 and above without shaders.
- Tested with Fabric 1.20.3 using Iris 1.7.0 and Sodium 0.5.8 and above with shaders.
